text_block_list.text:
One evening. After finishing some shopping,
I was walking through the shopping district when—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, people are
gathering over there, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Could this be an impromptu pro wrestling match?!
Then I want in on the action!

That can't be right.
As I stepped closer—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hey, masked girl over there!
Care to give it a try~?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!
I'll do it, count me in, failure is not an option!
Even though I have no idea what I'm doing!
Let me briefly explain the raffle. A raffle is 'a lottery drawing you enter using raffle tickets.'

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a lottery ticket! Come to think of it,
I received one earlier, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: To think this was the entry ticket to be used here!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Trainer,
shall we take this on as a tag team?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: There's only one chance...! Will this double-team attack bring victory, or will it backfire!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, Olé!

Together, the two of us gripped the lever
and gave the raffle drum a vigorous spin.
And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Que!? Could this be... a jackpot, yes!?
A hot! springs! trip voucher!!!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Which means
I can go with someone!?
choice_data_list: Good for you, feel free to use it however you like!
That's great, you can use it however you like!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno!
In that case, the one coming with me is...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass, Grass, Graaass!
Let's go on a hot springs trip together...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—No, no no no.
We'd better think this through...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I guess it really is better
not to invite Grass after all, yes...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because!!
El can see it. I can see it, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Her excitement peaking, El splashes around playfully
in the bathtub. But Grass doesn't join in and scolds her!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El playing pro-wrestler in the room,
Grass scolding her! El starting a pillow fight, repeat previous sentence!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: What El-El wants from a hot spring trip and what Grass wants are completely, utterly, totally mismatched, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass is a graceful, refined, and gentle Yamato Nadeshiko
who loves Japanese harmony, after all, desu.
choice_data_list: Then what are you going to do?
Then what are you going to do?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I must find someone else, desu! Someone who won't get mad
when El cuts loose, and will join in the fun...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho, here's the perfect person for the job! Trainer, let's go together!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you come with El, it's all-you-can-splash hot springs,
all-you-can-eat until your belly bursts,
and all-you-can-challenge matches, desu yo!

Words completely devoid of tranquility line the page.
And what catches the eye most of all is...
choice_data_list: Is it okay to go during the season?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué? During the season?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, dat is true...
If they return with their bellies completely stuffed...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to fly at the racetrack, desu.
I'll just be a condor tumbling along the course...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Let's go once the Twinkle Series settles down
and we're completely free!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh!
Then that's a promise, cross your heart, hope to die, yes?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling even more motivated now!
I'll do my best to win that hot spring trip reward, desu!

And so, we decided to hold onto the hot spring voucher for a while.
With yet another goal to aim for, El Condor Pasa's morale surged even higher!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oho! 1st Prize! Even if it's not the grand prize, we've scored something pretty amazing here!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A "Special Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak." And if you're leaving
the cooking to me, I have no choice but to go all out!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "I'll make sure you get to eat it seasoned just the way you like, Trainer-desu!"

It seems El Condor Pasa is going to
cook the meal herself.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*, welcome to Ristorante El-El.
How would you like that cooked, desu ka?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You can choose from two types!
"Almost Raw" or "Extremely Rare"!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: You can choose from 3 different kinds of sauce, too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Chili sauce! Mustard sauce!
And habanero sauce, DESUUU!!"
...It was a restaurant from hell.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Si, you are right! With this stamina boost,
I can do my best this year too!

El Condor Pasa was overjoyed to receive
such a highly nutritious prize.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, missed the grand prize!
Still, it's a massive bounty, a bountiful harvest, a sea of carotene!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Plus, if we use this mountain of carrots,
it looks like we can do the ultimate training, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll stick them all right into El's mask!
All lined up horizontally in a row!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And when you run along the training track like that, a hungry Spe-chan will chase after you, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off. Ciao!

There's no way something like that could happen.
When I followed behind, however...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, what an amazing carrot~!
Wait up, El-chan~!!

...It went just as planned. When I eat them,
I'll give one to Special Week too.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gaaah!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm... so shocked...
I was hoping for something more special...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it's gonna be, it's a one-carrot showdown, baybee!
El-El vs. the Lottery Guy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's play Rock-Paper-Scissors, and if El wins,
please trade for the hot springs ticket♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: T-That's impossible, seriously...!

—Negotiation failed. In the end, El Condor Pasa
sheepishly took back the one stick she had received.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Noooo! After spinning with all my might,
this is what I get?! Goddammit!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
However, Trainer,
this is no ordinary tissue!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Since the world's strongest El-El won it,
it's the 'world's strongest tissue', yeeeees♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I MEAN, A TISSUE IS STILL JUST
A DAMN TISSUEEEE!!
GODDAMMIT!!

No matter how hard I strain, it won't upgrade the prize.
I'll just blow my nose with it later.
